vb_textbox.text: There seem to be four gnome colours. I started selecting the most vivid or intense coloured gnomes. However, the number of mushrooms dropped I switched to the washed out coloured gnomes. If that didn't work I tried selecting the gnomes with the most pointy hat. The number of mushrooms seemed to cycle up and down. So spotting a low point would trigger a switch to a different type of gnome. At some point the game seemed to speed up - and said I was too slow. So start hitting the space bar as soon as you've chosen your gnome.I'm not sure but I think selecting quickly increased the score - certainly being too slow gives you zero.
